Earlier scenes:
这是古代的故事。孟子小的时候，他的爸爸很早就去世了。从他的家到墓地很近，所以他每天老是从早到晚去墓地跟朋友们玩玩儿。他的妈妈觉得在墓地玩儿，害得，所以他们搬家。搬家对孟子有好的影响，他才五岁，可是每天不是写字就是帮妈妈的工作。

This scene:
他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 他很聪明的人，难怪他成为有名的人：很聪明

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 他很聪明的人：他是个很聪明的人，A noun phrase such as “a very intelligent person” needs a linking verb and a measure word after the subject. [rule: adjective_predicate]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 成为有名的人：成为了有名的人，The becoming is presented as a completed result, so add 了 after the verb. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
3. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 难怪他成为了有名的人：难怪成为了有名的人，After the same person has just been named in the preceding clause, omit the repeated pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

items.reason: “他很聪明的人” incorrectly combines an adjective predicate with the noun 人; adding 是个 makes it a grammatical noun predicate.
“成为有名的人” can be used without 了 here, so adding 了 is optional rather than a required correction.
Repeating 他 in the new clause is natural and clear, so it does not need to be omitted.
